newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Medco Energi unit to launch $50 mln FRN.
newsitem.headline: Medco Energi unit to launch $50 mln FRN.

text.p: PT Medco Energi plans to borrow US$50 million through a debut Euro floating rate note issued through Medco Finance Co BV, said arranger Dongsuh Securities.
The notes will be guaranteed by PT Meta Epsi Duta Corp, which is the holding company of PT Medco Energi group. The deal will be secured by a pledge of shares of PT Medco Energi Corp.
The notes will carry a maturity of five years with a put option after the second anniversary.
The issue will be priced at par. Redemption is at 100.00 in year two, 100.20 in year three, 100.40 in year four and 100.60 at maturity.
The coupon will be set at 270-290 basis points over the six-month London Interbank Offered Rate. The all-in yield to investors will range from 3.05 percent to 3.10 percent.
The notes will be listed in Luxembourg.
Proceeds of the issue will be used for general working capital and for refinancing existing debts of the borrower.
Launch is planned for November 18. Roadshows will be held in Seoul on November 25 and in Hong Kong on November 27, Dongsuh Securities said.
